preferred.action: mint a short-lived OAuth2 client-credentials token at run time

fallback.action: use an already-issued short-lived bearer token
fallback.warning: Dryad access tokens expire on a short timescale; client credentials are the durable route

execution_chain: prepare short-lived DRYAD_TOKEN in runner environment
run frozen v0.72 opaque exact-byte transport
delete raw mixed CSV bytes before artifact upload
post_success_rule: download the workflow artifact, verify the Stage-A receipts, and commit exact header SHA/manifests in a separate revision before any safe-row projection
reason_execution_not_automatic: credential-bearing workflow is manual-only and must not run merely because code was pushed
